html_title: Baseless claim that Henry Kissinger gave a WHO speech about ‘mandatory forcible’ vaccinations recirculates
Airlines are not banning vaccinated people from flying
Income tax and national debt both existed 100 years ago
Video supposedly showing Muslim woman telling people to ‘cover up’ is fake
Post from ‘Nobel Committee member’ is satire
Toby Carvery isn’t giving away a free carvery to celebrate ‘National Yorkshire Pudding Week’
Video shows street vendors in Spain, not people selling items looted in France
AI mushroom cloud video shared with false claims it shows Ukraine
Donald Trump did not post on Truth Social about the Republicans already winning the 2026 midterms
Viral video doesn’t show zombie knives delivery to ‘migrant hotel’
